visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Define Before Use
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The code calls a function that is defined further down and works only because of hoisting. Move the definition above the call so it reads top to bottom. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Defining things before they are used makes the order of execution obvious, and it keeps working if the function is later changed into a function expression, where hoisting would not help.
